name: Hako Ni Go Itai
source:
Short horror sound novel game created by members of large Japanese message board 2channel.

The season is autumn.

Via an Internet message board, a group of people agree to meet up at a certain location, for the purpose of ending their own lives.

"Do not pry into one another." That was the rule these young women agreed to uphold when they grouped. However, at the apartment block where they planned to end their lives, its elevator suddenly stopped due to a power outage.

With far too much free time on their hands as they waited for the elevator system to restore, one of the members grew tired of waiting quietly and broke the silence.

"Hey guys, do you have any secrets that you just couldn't tell anybody? I do. Since we're all gonna die anyway, don't you think it's better for us just to talk about them here than to take them to our graves?"

Taking in turns, each member reveal their secrets amidst the sombre atmosphere...

[Translation of the [URL=http://hakonigo.web.fc2.com/story.html]official plot summary[/URL]]
translation:
一款由日本大型论坛2channel成员制作的短篇恐怖有声小说游戏。

故事发生在秋天。

一群人通过网络留言板约定在某地见面，打算结束自己的生命。

“不要打听彼此的事情。”这是年轻女性们集合时约定遵守的规则。然而，在她们计划结束生命的公寓楼里，电梯突然因停电停止运行。

等待电梯恢复的时间太长，其中一人厌倦了沉默，打破了寂静。

“大家有没有什么绝对不能告诉别人的秘密？我有一个。反正我们都要死了，不如现在说出来，总比把秘密带进坟墓好，对吧？”

每个人轮流在阴郁的气氛中揭开秘密……

[译自[URL=http://hakonigo.web.fc2.com/story.html]官方剧情简介[/URL]]
